async function craftIronPickaxeUpgradeIfNeeded(bot) {
    // This function determines if an iron pickaxe is needed and available. It first checks if the pickaxe is already in the inventory, returning if so. Next, it verifies that at least three iron ingots and two sticks are present in the inventory. It attempts to craft the pickaxe directly; if that fails, it ensures a crafting table is available by gathering wood and placing the table nearby. Finally, it retries the crafting process and confirms the iron pickaxe is successfully added to the inventory.
}
